name: key-value
title: Key Value
description: An editor for key/value pairs where each row has a monospaced key field, a value field and a remove button, plus an add button that appends an empty row. Pasting a .env listing fills several rows at once.
use: A settings or deploy form must edit a variable number of key/value pairs.
avoid: Every row pairs a text field with a growing textarea, so long values make rows tall in a narrow panel.
a11y: Fields rely on placeholders rather than labels, though the list uses roles and errors are linked with aria-describedby and role alert. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark form under a small heading and a grey hint line. Each row pairs a narrow outlined key box with a wider outlined value box, both with grey borders, followed by a square cross button; a full-width outlined Add button sits under the rows.
behaves: Typing in a key or value updates the pair immediately and checks for duplicate keys, showing a red message under the field. Add appends a new empty row and focuses it, the cross deletes a row, and pasting several KEY=value lines expands them into separate rows.
customise: Pass a default or controlled array of pairs and a change handler; placeholders, row limits, duplicate rules, paste, trimming, disabled state and validation callbacks are props.
weight: light: Plain inputs with local state and no animation, canvas or polling.
